sponsored.t: Provides additional tax exemptions for two qualified veterans living in the same household
sponsored.sum: Provides additional tax exemptions on qualifying residential real property where two or more qualified veterans live in the same household.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring utility companies maintain a toll free number for reporting service outages
sponsored.sum: Requires utility companies maintain a toll free number for consumers to call to report service outages which shall be made available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.

sponsored.t: Requires the results of any outage management system stress test conducted in the state by a utility company to be posted online
sponsored.sum: Requires the results of any outage management system stress test conducted in the state by a utility company to be posted online and such results to be sent to the temporary president of the senate, the speaker of the assembly and the chairs of the senate and assembly standing committees on energy.

sponsored.t: Enacts the New York commission for the deaf and hard of hearing act
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "New York commission for the deaf and hard of hearing act".

sponsored.t: Establishes the bullet-proof vests for officers fund
sponsored.sum: Establishes the bullet-proof vests for officers fund.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring prescription drug containers be labeled with a description of the size, shape, color and imprint of the prescription drug it contains if such drug is in tablet or capsule form
sponsored.sum: Requires prescription drug containers be labeled with a description of the size, shape, color and imprint of the prescription drug it contains if such drug is in tablet or capsule form.

sponsored.t: Grants peace officer status to investigators employed by the office of the corporation counsel of the city of Yonkers
sponsored.sum: Grants peace officer status to investigators employed by the office of the corporation counsel of the city of Yonkers.

sponsored.t: Grants peace officer status to parking and code enforcement officers of the city of Yonkers
sponsored.sum: Designates parking and code enforcement officers employed by the city of Yonkers as peace officers.

sponsored.t: Prohibits state and federal law enforcement acting within New York from covering their faces or otherwise concealing their identity, except in certain circumstances
sponsored.sum: Prohibits state and federal law enforcement operating within New York from covering their faces or otherwise concealing their identity, except in limited circumstances.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the use of certain parking management technologies in the city of Yonkers
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the city council of the city of Yonkers to, by adoption of a local law or ordinance, provide for the use of certain smart parking management technologies by the city of Yonkers.

sponsored.t: Directs the commissioner of criminal justice services to study the effectiveness and accuracy of devices used to estimate blood alcohol content by law enforcement agencies
sponsored.sum: Directs the commissioner of the division of criminal justice services to study the effectiveness and accuracy of devices used to estimate blood alcohol content by law enforcement agencies.

sponsored.t: Separates interscholastic athletic championships between public and non-public schools
sponsored.sum: Separates interscholastic athletic championships between public and non-public schools.

sponsored.t: Relates to designating state and city university campuses as early voting sites and polling sites
sponsored.sum: Designates campuses which are operated by the state university of New York with at least sixteen thousand enrolled students and an on campus dormitory as early voting sites and polling sites; provides that such designation requirements shall not apply where an early voting site or polling site is already designated within one mile of the geographic boundaries of such campus.

sponsored.t: Requires that digital coupons are made available to consumers in paper form of identical value
sponsored.sum: Requires that retail mercantile establishments offering digital coupons make such coupons available to consumers in paper form of identical value; provides exceptions; provides for violations and penalties.

sponsored.t: Relates to a refugee resettlement program
sponsored.sum: Directs the department of social services to establish a refugee resettlement program with the goals of achieving economic and social self-sufficiency, assisting victims of human trafficking, and assuring proper foster care for unaccompanied refugees.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "rebuild our schools act"
sponsored.sum: Relates to the apportionment of moneys for capital outlays and debt service for school building purposes.

sponsored.t: Relates to providing translators at certain polling place locations
sponsored.sum: Relates to providing translators at certain polling place locations if fifteen percent of the number of voting age citizens who speak the same language other than English at home reside in the district where such polling place is located.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring the disclosure of fees on certain internet websites and mobile applications
sponsored.sum: Requires the disclosure of fees on internet websites and mobile applications which allow consumers to acquire loans with terms of less than one month.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "cash acceptance act"
sponsored.sum: Prohibits food-service and retail establishments from refusing to accept cash as payment for goods or services; calls for a civil fine if an establishment should refuse cash as payment.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "school aid equity act"
sponsored.sum: Increases foundation aid for school districts that meet five variables impacting academic success: free or reduced lunch, English language learners, wealth ratio, enrollment, special education, and being located in a high wealth ratio county.

sponsored.t: Directs the commissioner of transportation to conduct a study on the implementation of traffic control devices at intersections with a high volume of visual and hearing impaired pedestrians
sponsored.sum: Directs the commissioner of transportation to conduct a study on the implementation of traffic control devices at intersections with a high volume of visual and hearing impaired pedestrians.

sponsored.t: Requires monthly inspections of all AED equipment
sponsored.sum: Requires monthly inspections of all AED equipment in all schools.

sponsored.t: Makes certain exceptions for violations pertaining to certain mufflers and exhaust systems
sponsored.sum: Excepts violations pertaining to mufflers and exhaust systems for cars, motorcycle exhaust devices without internal baffles and motorcycle exhaust devices that are intentionally designed to allow for the internal baffling to be fully or partially removed or interchangeable from having a summons not issued or having a summons dismissed if the violation is corrected.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "drag racing and speeding enforcement act"
sponsored.sum: Imposes five points on a person's license for being convicted of participating in speed contests and races.

sponsored.t: Establishes Eid al-Fitr and Eid al-Adha as school holidays
sponsored.sum: Establishes Eid al-Fitr and Eid al-Adha as school holidays, with dates established by religious law and tradition; allows for school districts and municipalities with a population of less than fifty thousand to opt into the recognition of such holidays.

sponsored.t: Requires electric companies to provide alternative measures to ensure customers with documented need for essential electricity for medical needs have access to electricity during power outages
sponsored.sum: Requires electric companies to provide alternative measures to ensure customers with documented need for essential electricity for medical needs have access to electricity during power outages; requires electric companies to provide generators or lodging for such individuals and transportation for medical devices.

sponsored.t: Relates to allowing the possession and sale of electronic dart guns and electronic stun guns for self-defense
sponsored.sum: Relates to allowing the possession and sale of electronic dart guns and electronic stun guns for self-defense; adds such weapons in the definition of obstructing governmental administration by means of a self-defense spray device.

sponsored.t: Provides a reimbursement to small businesses and residential consumers of certain utilities for failure to provide contracted services; requires the Long Island power authority to do the same
sponsored.sum: Provides a reimbursement to small businesses and residential consumers of certain utilities for failure to provide contracted services; requires the Long Island power authority to do the same.

sponsored.t: Requires a joint report by the state board of elections and state education department concerning the safety of students and staff at schools used as polling places for elections
sponsored.sum: Requires a joint report by the state board of elections and state education department concerning the safety of students and staff at schools used as polling places for elections.

sponsored.t: Directs the commissioner of education to establish standards for the security and safety of school grounds
sponsored.sum: Directs the commissioner of education, in conjunction with the superintendent of state police and the commissioner of the division of homeland security and emergency services, to establish standards for the security and safety of school grounds.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "education funding census update act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "education funding census update act"; updates the census numbers used to calculate certain education funding.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "mansion tax adjustment act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "mansion tax adjustment act"; increases the sales price threshold for real property conveyances that will trigger additional sales tax.

sponsored.t: Expands the definition of tuition for children with handicapping conditions
sponsored.sum: Expands the definition of tuition for children with handicapping conditions.

sponsored.t: Prohibits cyber-bullying
sponsored.sum: Establishes that any person who knowingly engages in a repeated course of cyberbullying of a minor is guilty of an unclassified misdemeanor punishable by a fine of not more than one thousand dollars, or by a period of imprisonment not to exceed one year, or both.

sponsored.t: Provides public access to epinephrine auto-injector devices at schools
sponsored.sum: Provides public access to epinephrine auto-injector devices at schools; establishes public access epinephrine auto-injector device providers.

sponsored.t: Relates to indoor air quality in schools
sponsored.sum: Relates to indoor air quality in schools.

sponsored.t: Provides for the trustees of the state university of New York to establish a college of engineering and applied sciences in the city of Yonkers
sponsored.sum: Provides for the trustees of the state university of New York to establish a four-year college of engineering and applied sciences in the city of Yonkers within the state university system.

sponsored.t: Limits the substitution of abuse-deterrent analgesic opioid drug products for analgesic opioids lacking such technology
sponsored.sum: Provides for patient access to FDA approved abuse-deterrent technology to help combat opioid abuse.

sponsored.t: Extends the timeline for the return of security deposits for residential rental agreements from fourteen days to thirty days
sponsored.sum: Extends the timeline for the return of security deposits for residential rental agreements from fourteen days to thirty days.

sponsored.t: Relates to creating a bridge suicide barrier fund
sponsored.sum: Creates a fund to be used to research certain bridges being equipped with suicide barriers.

sponsored.t: Requires businesses which provide for someone to spoof a telephone number to keep certain records
sponsored.sum: Requires businesses which provide for someone to spoof a telephone number to keep records of the phone calls placed with their services.

sponsored.t: Requires a yearly inspection of all audiological testing equipment
sponsored.sum: Requires a yearly inspection of all audiological testing equipment in all schools.

sponsored.t: Relates to the age limitation for judges
sponsored.sum: Provides that a judge of a city court outside the city of New York may only serve until the last day of December next after such person shall be seventy-six years of age; makes exceptions for judges already elected or appointed to office.

sponsored.t: Provides for tax credit for the adoption of pets from animal shelter
sponsored.sum: Provides for tax credit for the adoption of pets from an animal shelter up to $250 per pet.

sponsored.t: Permits specialist assistants to prescribe controlled substances as a practitioner
sponsored.sum: Permits specialist assistants to prescribe controlled substances as a practitioner.

sponsored.t: Relates to the licensing of sign language interpreters and creates a state board for sign language interpreting
sponsored.sum: Relates to the licensing of sign language interpreters; creates a state board for sign language interpreting.

sponsored.t: Requires cell towers to be equipped with a back-up power source in case of a power outage
sponsored.sum: Requires cell towers to be equipped with a back-up power source in case of a power outage.

sponsored.t: Relates to including if a person has autism spectrum disorder on their driver's license; repealer
sponsored.sum: Includes a distinctive mark on a person's driver's license if a person has autism spectrum disorder.

sponsored.t: Relates to renaming the empire state trail the Governor Malcolm Wilson empire state trail
sponsored.ls: New York State Urban Development Corporation Act
sponsored.sum: Renames the empire state trail the Governor Malcolm Wilson empire state trail.

sponsored.t: Requires annual screenings for depression of students in grades seven through twelve
sponsored.sum: Requires annual screenings for depression of students in grades seven through twelve; requires the department of education and the department of health to review data pertaining to the results of such screenings for local and statewide trends concerning teenage depression.

sponsored.t: Permits funeral directors to sell insurance
sponsored.sum: Permits funeral directors to sell insurance.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the manufacture, sale, or offer for sale of a decorative or facsimile license plate that is substantially similar to a license plate issued by the department of motor vehicles
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the manufacture, sale, or offer for sale of a decorative or facsimile license plate of a size, shape, color and design which is substantially similar to a license plate issued by the department of motor vehicles, such that such decorative or facsimile license plate appears to be a license plate issued by the department of motor vehicles.

sponsored.t: Allows school districts to canvass from the five highest civil service examination ratings
sponsored.sum: Allows school districts to canvass from the five highest civil service examination ratings.

sponsored.t: Requires police officer training programs on interacting with individuals with a disability
sponsored.sum: Requires police officer training programs on interacting with individuals with a disability with special emphasis on the techniques needed to improve interactions with individuals that are blind or deaf or hard of hearing; provides such training shall be created in consultation with the justice center for the protection of people with special needs.

sponsored.t: Relates to the seizure and redemption of vehicles used in illegal races, exhibitions or contests of speed
sponsored.sum: Relates to the seizure and redemption of vehicles used in illegal races, exhibitions or contests of speed.

sponsored.t: Increases the penalties for stopping, standing, or parking in handicapped spaces without a handicapped permit
sponsored.sum: Increases the penalties for stopping, standing, or parking in handicapped spaces without a handicapped permit to not less than one hundred fifty dollars nor more than three hundred dollars for the first offense and three hundred to five hundred fifty dollars for the second offense occurring within a period of five years within the state.

sponsored.t: Requires that parents of students at student orientations, back to school nights, or other beginning of year events receive notification of eligibility for free or reduced price meals for students
sponsored.sum: Requires that parents of students at student orientations, back to school nights, or other beginning of year events, at schools that participate in the national school lunch program or school breakfast program, receive notification of eligibility, and access to application, for free or reduced price meals for students.

sponsored.t: Requires certain state police vehicles to carry jumper cables and requires officers operating such vehicles offer to use such jumper cables on disabled vehicles
sponsored.sum: Requires certain state police vehicles to carry jumper cables; requires officers operating such vehicles offer to use such jumper cables on disabled vehicles.

sponsored.t: Provides a tax deduction for fertility preservation services
sponsored.sum: Provides a tax deduction for fertility preservation services in an amount up to $1,000.

sponsored.t: Exempts certain security guards from annual in-service training courses
sponsored.sum: Exempts registered security guards with a bachelor's degree or higher from an accredited college or university in criminal justice or an equivalent from annual in service-training courses.

sponsored.t: Includes in facilitating aggravated unlicensed operation of a motor vehicle consenting to the operation of a motor vehicle by a person who is under eighteen years old without a license resulting in injury
sponsored.sum: Includes in facilitating aggravated unlicensed operation of a motor vehicle consenting to the operation of a motor vehicle by a person who is less than eighteen years of age who has never had a license or the privilege of operating such motor vehicle in this state and the vehicle is operated upon a public highway by such person resulting in physical injury to another person.

sponsored.t: Prohibits increases in rates of homeowners' insurance in excess of twenty-five percent per year
sponsored.sum: Prohibits increases in rates of homeowners' insurance in excess of twenty-five percent per year except where agreed to in the policy.

sponsored.t: Extends the time when the state is liable for damages suffered by any person from defects in state highways
sponsored.sum: Extends the time when the state is liable for damages suffered by any person from defects in state highways to between April 1 and December 1.

sponsored.t: Provides for school district employees who have been provisionally appointed to a position for at least nine months without an exam being offered for such position to receive a permanent appointment
sponsored.sum: Provides for school district employees who have been provisionally appointed to a position for at least nine months without an exam being offered for such position to receive a permanent appointment in such position.

sponsored.t: Extends the utilization of limited permit practice of medicine to private offices or clinics in urgent care settings, prisons, schools, and universities
sponsored.sum: Extends the utilization of limited permit practice of medicine to private offices or clinics in urgent care settings, prisons, schools, and universities; extends the duration of such limited permits to three years.

sponsored.t: Requires private investigators to notify the state police when they are employed by a foreign government or foreign national and requires the state police to maintain a registry of certain private investigators
sponsored.sum: Requires private investigators to notify the state police when they are employed by a foreign government or foreign national; requires the state police to maintain a registry of all private investigators who have been employed by a foreign government or foreign national.

sponsored.t: Establishes statewide pilot programs promoting the use of alternative treatments for individuals suffering from chronic lower back pain
sponsored.sum: Establishes statewide pilot programs for the purpose of promoting the use of alternatives to opioid treatment for individuals suffering from chronic lower back pain by offering access to nonpharmacologic treatments such as acupuncture and chiropractic services.

sponsored.t: Enacts "CJ's law" in relation to increasing the penalties for leaving the scene of an accident without reporting where such accident resulted in the death of a minor
sponsored.sum: Enacts "CJ's law" in relation to increasing the penalties for leaving the scene of an accident without reporting where such accident resulted in the death of a minor to a class C felony punishable by a fine of not less than four thousand nor more than eight thousand dollars in addition to any other penalties provided by law.

sponsored.t: Relates to certain authorizations for fiscal intermediaries
sponsored.sum: Directs the commissioner of health to provide authorizations to all fiscal intermediaries that timely submit a request for authorization prior to January 1, 2026; details information required for such authorizations; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Ensures continuity of care for cancer patients during insurance contract negotiations
sponsored.sum: Ensures continuity of care for cancer patients during insurance contract negotiations by requiring insurance coverage and treatment continue until the conclusion of care.

sponsored.t: Provides for a window of eighteen months for people to receive certain vital records without paying a fee
sponsored.sum: Provides for a window of eighteen months for people to receive birth, death, marriage, and dissolution of marriage records without paying a fee.

sponsored.t: Permits judges and justices to purchase and use body armor
sponsored.sum: Permits judges and justices to purchase and use body armor.

sponsored.t: Prohibits state and federal law enforcement acting within New York from covering their faces or otherwise concealing their identity, except in certain circumstances
sponsored.sum: Prohibits state and federal law enforcement acting within New York from covering their faces or otherwise concealing their identity, except in limited circumstances; grants the attorney general authority to enforce civil penalties.

sponsored.t: Requires harness racetrack locations awarded a gaming facility license maintain live racing activity
sponsored.ls: Racing, Pari-Mutuel Wagering and Breeding Law
sponsored.sum: Requires harness racetrack locations awarded a gaming facility license maintain live racing activity.

veto.text: VETO MESSAGE - No. 73 TO THE ASSEMBLY: I am returning herewith, without my approval, the following bill: Assembly Bill Number 7802-A, entitled: "AN ACT to amend the racing, pari-mutuel wagering and breeding law, in relation to requiring harness racetrack locations awarded a gaming facility license maintain live racing activity" NOT APPROVED This bill would have required MGM Yonkers, Inc. to maintain live racing at the premises even if it was awarded a commercial casino license. Subsequent to the passage of this bill, MGM Yonkers, Inc. withdrew its application seeking a commercial casino license, rendering this bill moot. Therefore, I am constrained to veto this bill. The bill is disapproved. (signed) KATHY HOCHUL __________

sponsored.t: Establishes an Alzheimer's disease outreach and education program
sponsored.sum: Removes the director of the office of the aging from deciding resources and information concerning Alzheimer's disease and any other dementia related matters; leaves such decisions to the commissioner of health.

sponsored.t: Relates to when and how notification of a data breach is to be provided to the department of financial services
sponsored.sum: Relates to when and how notification of a data breach is to be provided to the department of financial services.
